mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_order (order_no, supplier_id, warehouse_id, total_amount, status, purchaser_id, order_date, remark, company_id, delivery_method, is_tax_included, tax_rate, tax_amount, untaxed_amount, invoice_done) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{supplierId}, #{warehouseId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{purchaserId}, #{orderDate}, #{remark}, #{companyId}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{isTaxIncluded}, #{taxRate}, #{taxAmount}, #{untaxedAmount}, #{invoiceDone})
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('PO', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), LPAD(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(order_no, 11) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1, 4, '0')) FROM purchase_order WHERE order_no LIKE CONCAT('PO', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), '%')
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO purchase_order_item (order_id, product_id, quantity, price, amount, remark) VALUES
(#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.price}, #{item.amount}, #{item.remark})
mapper.sql: po.id, po.order_no, po.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, po.warehouse_id, po.total_amount, po.status, po.purchaser_id, po.order_date, po.remark, po.created_at, po.company_id, po.delivery_method, po.is_tax_included, po.tax_rate, po.tax_amount, po.untaxed_amount, po.invoice_done
mapper.select: SELECT po.id, po.order_no, po.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, po.warehouse_id, po.total_amount, po.status, po.purchaser_id, po.order_date, po.remark, po.created_at, po.company_id, po.delivery_method, po.is_tax_included, po.tax_rate, po.tax_amount, po.untaxed_amount, po.invoice_done FROM purchase_order po LEFT JOIN supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.id WHERE po.id = #{id}

SELECT poi.id, poi.order_id, poi.product_id, p.product_name, p.spec, poi.quantity, poi.price, poi.amount FROM purchase_order_item poi LEFT JOIN product p ON poi.product_id = p.id WHERE poi.order_id = #{orderId}
